shots.description: Dashboard for November 2026: income, spending, leftover, savings rate, spending donut, budget progress, recent transactions, upcoming bills.
Budget page for November 2026: monthly limit per category, progress bars, over-budget warnings and cut-back tips.
Savings goals page: emergency fund, family vacation and next car, with progress bars and contribute forms.
Dashboard on a phone-sized screen (390x844): stats stack two-across, navigation wraps, donut chart below.
